claim_text: After his 2018 meeting with Kim Jong Un in Singapore, Trump told reporters the United States would be stopping the war games to save a tremendous amount of money, unless and until future negotiations were not going as they should.
quote: We will be stopping the war games, which will save us a tremendous amount of money, unless and until we see the future negotiation is not going along like it should,
confidence_justification: Verbatim on-record remark to reporters, reproduced by CBS News.
